notice: Provenance categories only. A category does not establish ownership, public-domain status, permission or commercial-use rights.

source_types.description: A premise, character, setting, scenario or story direction supplied by the user.
A concept developed for the project with AI assistance and human creative selection, revision or authorship contributions.
An identified work believed to be out of copyright in one or more specified territories, subject to edition, translation and related-rights checks.
A traditional tale, motif, myth, legend or oral narrative documented through identified sources and versions.
A real event, historical record, public fact or unresolved incident used as research material for a fictional work.
A work made available under an identified open licence whose terms must be checked for adaptation, commercial use, attribution and share-alike obligations.
A work used under documented permission or licence from the relevant rights holder.
A work created under a written commission or services agreement defining relevant rights, ownership and permitted exploitation.
A reference consulted for broad themes, genre conventions, subject matter or research context, not as a source to adapt or reproduce.

territory_scope: A future assessment must specify the territories where intended publication or distribution will occur. Avoid a single unqualified GLOBAL_CLEAR label.
